derives_from: docs/fable5-app-integration-readiness/contracts/environment_target_contract.json (C13, C14) and mock-harness mock_environment_scenarios (ME-01..ME-06); boot validation copies the fail-fast named-variable pattern of app/src/lib/supabase/env.ts without modifying that file

env_vars.QA_RESEARCH_TARGET: required when QA_RESEARCH_ENABLED=true; M1 accepted values: 'mock' only
env_vars.QA_RESEARCH_ENABLED: feature flag; absent or false hides the page, nav block, and returns 404-style envelope from the route
env_vars.QA_MODE_EXCERPT_LOGGING: optional; default false; audit excerpt opt-in

checks: target present and in the M1 enum; missing or unknown = invalid verdict, route answers error envelope only (ME-01)

production sentinel: any target value containing 'prod' is rejected structurally because the type enum has no production member; the check exists as defense in depth and its failure message names the variable (ME-04)
model id allowlist check for model-client config (invalid ids fail boot, not first request)
excerpt flag parsed strictly; any value other than 'true' is false
boot_validation.failure_behavior: invalid verdict is cached and every request short-circuits to error envelope; no partial feature operation

labeling.banner: qa-research page renders a persistent MOCK_ONLY banner sourced from the verdict, not from a hardcoded string (ME-02)
labeling.target_chip: adapter healthProbe target label + fixture_manifest_hash shown in the page header (ME-03)
labeling.envelope_echo: every response envelope carries environment_echo { target, mock: true }; UI cross-checks echo against banner state and surfaces mismatch as an error banner (ME-05)
labeling.purpose: a judge or QA reviewer can never mistake mock output for live corpus output

non_goals_m1: no preview or production target values in the enum, config examples, or fixtures
no runtime target switching; changing target requires restart and re-boot-validation (ME-06)
